description: CloudWatch Alarms, SNS topic, and EventBridge rule that act as the detection layer for the sovereign-aiops agent. Fires on OOMKilled, high latency, 5XX error rate, and ECS CPU overload. Routes events to the MCP Server for autonomous remediation.
capabilities: Creates SNS topic as central notification channel for all alarms
Creates OOMKilled alarm for EKS pods (conditional on eks_cluster_name)
Creates ALB p99 latency alarm (conditional on alb_arn_suffix)
Creates ALB 5XX error rate alarm using metric math (conditional on alb_arn_suffix)
Creates ECS CPU overload alarm for the MCP Server (conditional on ecs_cluster_name)
Creates EventBridge rule routing ALARM state changes to the MCP Server
Transforms EventBridge events into structured JSON payload before delivery
Optionally subscribes an email address to the SNS topic
inputs_optional: ecs_cluster_name (default: empty — ECS CPU alarm disabled)
ecs_service_name (default: empty — ECS CPU alarm disabled)
llm_hints: No VPC dependency — CloudWatch, SNS, EventBridge are global services
All alarms are conditional — pass only the inputs available at the time
alb_arn_suffix format is app/name/id — get it from module.ecs_fargate outputs
EventBridge target is disabled if mcp_server_lambda_arn is empty — useful for initial deploy before MCP Server exists
OOMKilled metric requires kube-state-metrics installed in the EKS cluster (ContainerInsights namespace)
sns_topic_arn output should also be passed to the Lambda HITL notifier as its publish target
security_notes: SNS topic encrypted with aws/sns managed key
EventBridge rule only routes alarms with this project's name prefix — no cross-project noise
alarm_actions and ok_actions both point to SNS — operator notified on recovery too
treat_missing_data=notBreaching prevents false alarms when metrics are not yet available
